description: This file declares the AWCContainer class, which manages application containers within the WPEFramework's ProcessContainers namespace. It includes methods for starting, stopping, and querying container state, and maintains internal state such as process ID and application state.

classes.name: AWCContainer
classes.description: A class that manages application containers, providing control over their lifecycle and state within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID associated with the container.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with a specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, with a specified timeout.

methods.name: notifyStateChange
methods.description: Handles notifications about state changes in the container.

methods.name: WaitUntilAWCReady
methods.description: Waits until the AWC (Application Web Container) is ready.
